:::{#exm-positivity}
#### Checking positivity

In the population of @exm-exchangeability-strata,
$\Pf{A = 1 \mid L = 0} = 0.2$ and $\Pf{A = 1 \mid L = 1} = 0.7$.
Both probabilities lie strictly between 0 and 1,
so positivity (@def-positivity) holds:
each severity stratum contains both treated and untreated patients.

If instead every severe patient were treated,
then $\Pf{A = 1 \mid L = 1} = 1$,
the population would contain no untreated severe patients,
and the data could not tell us what $\E{Y(0) \mid L = 1}$ is:
a positivity violation (@def-positivity-violation).

:::
